metadata.author: Chatbot Dev Team
metadata.description: Enhanced intents with real estate and manufacturing industry support.

responses: Hello! 👋 How can I help you today?
Hi there! What can I do for you?
Hey! Great to see you. How can I assist?
Welcome! Need help with anything?
Good day! How may I be of service?
Hi! Ready to help you with whatever you need.
I'd be happy to check that. Can you provide your Order ID?

validation.errorMessage: Order ID must be a number, optionally prefixed with '#'.

responses: Which product would you like to know about? You can share the product name or SKU.

product_query.prompt: Please provide the product name or SKU.

validation.errorMessage: Please enter at least 2 characters for the product query.

responses: You can reach an agent by Call, Email, or WhatsApp. Which would you prefer?
Call us at +91-800-555-0100. Would you like me to place the call on your device?
You can email our support team at support@example.com. Would you like me to compose an email for you?
I'll prepare a WhatsApp message for an agent. Which department is this for?

validation.errorMessage: Please choose one of the following: Sales, Support, Billing.

brief.prompt: Give a one-line summary of your issue.

validation.errorMessage: Please provide a brief description between 5 and 200 characters.

postAction.message: I've created a WhatsApp message. Click to open WhatsApp and send it to the agent.

doctor.prompt: Which doctor would you like to see?

validation.errorMessage: Please provide the doctor's name.

responses: I can set a medication reminder. What's the medication name and schedule?

Please specify a valid dosage.
Please specify the frequency.

responses: Please provide the last 4 digits of your account or the account nickname so I can find the right account.

account_identifier.prompt: Enter last 4 digits or account nickname.

validation.errorMessage: Please enter exactly 4 digits or a valid nickname (3-20 characters).

responses: Tell me the transaction ID or describe the issue (e.g., 'failed payment', 'unauthorized charge').
